title: My God, I Believe in Thee
description: Traditional prayer expressing the theological virtues of faith, hope, and charity with contrition
text: O my God, I believe in Thee, I hope in Thee, I love Thee above all things with all my soul, with all my heart and with all my strength; I love Thee because Thou art infinitely good and worthy of being loved; and because I love Thee, I repent with all my heart of having offended Thee; have mercy on me, a sinner. Amen.
